data.one_liner: A horizontal overlapped carousel widget where the centered item appears on top of the stack.
data.what_it_does: Displays a list of widgets in a horizontal carousel with overlapping cards. The center card is rendered above others and can be skewed or blurred via parameters.
use_when: You need a simple carousel with an overlapping visual effect
You want to highlight the centered item with custom skew or blur
avoid_when: You require vertical scrolling or complex paging controls
You need extensive customization beyond overlap, skew, and blur
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget
Built‑in overlap, skew, and blur controls
Only builds widgets that are visible
